Offline process tests preserve the selected GPT-5.5 medium configuration, protect review across workers, retain interrupted reservations and preserve tracing/failure-artifact consumption.

Prepared dispatch validates allowanceRef and the explicit model before runtime preflight, derives category from the descriptor, and propagates a binding that nested dispatch cannot replace. Campaign allowance approval/status are available through shared execution; approval starts no jobs.

Exact discovery campaign plans can now be attached to allowance approvals. Started attempts survive cancellation and restart; revisions cannot erase or repurpose them. The existing campaign dispatcher attaches references and counts quota failures against finite attempts.
limits: Accepted discovery scan batches bind their jobs automatically. Context, review and learning job planning, immutable context isolation and the guided editor remain open.
